name: PhishGuard Pro — Automated Phishing Email Triage & Threat Intelligence Pipeline

parameters.jsCode:
const phishingKeywords = [
  'urgent', 'immediately', 'right away', 'asap', 'time sensitive',
  'act now', 'action required', 'immediate action', 'expires today',
  'deadline', 'last chance', 'final warning', 'final notice',
  'within 24 hours', 'within 48 hours', 'limited time',
  'don\'t delay', 'respond immediately', 'quick response needed',
  'account suspended', 'account locked', 'account compromised',
  'account verification', 'verify your account', 'confirm your identity',
  'unusual activity', 'suspicious activity', 'unauthorized access',
  'security alert', 'security warning', 'security notice',
  'password expired', 'password reset', 'update your password',
  'login attempt', 'failed login', 'breach detected',
  'identity theft', 'fraud alert', 'unauthorized transaction',
  'wire transfer', 'bank transfer', 'payment pending',
  'invoice attached', 'outstanding payment', 'overdue invoice',
  'refund pending', 'claim your refund', 'tax refund',
  'prize winner', 'you have won', 'lottery winner',
  'inheritance', 'beneficiary', 'unclaimed funds',
  'bitcoin', 'cryptocurrency', 'investment opportunity',
  'financial reward', 'bonus payment', 'compensation',
  'click here', 'click below', 'click the link',
  'log in here', 'sign in here', 'access your account',
  'confirm your details', 'update your information',
  'fill out the form', 'submit your details',
  'enter your credentials', 'provide your password',
  'social security number', 'ssn', 'credit card number',
  'bank account number', 'routing number',
  'helpdesk', 'it department', 'tech support',
  'system administrator', 'admin team',
  'payroll department', 'human resources',
  'ceo', 'chief executive', 'managing director',
  'on behalf of', 'authorized representative',
  'see attached', 'open attachment', 'review attached',
  'document enclosed', 'file attached', 'download attached',
  'open the document', 'enable macros', 'enable content',
  'enable editing', 'protected document', 'encrypted document',
  'legal action', 'law enforcement', 'police report',
  'court order', 'subpoena', 'arrest warrant',
  'account closure', 'service termination', 'permanent ban',
  'data loss', 'file deletion', 'account deletion',
  'penalty', 'fine', 'prosecution',
  'free gift', 'gift card', 'exclusive offer',
  'special promotion', 'selected winner', 'congratulations',
  'no cost', 'risk free', 'guaranteed',
  'double your', 'earn money', 'work from home',
  'this is not spam', 'this is not a scam',
  'this is legitimate', 'trusted sender',
  'do not share', 'confidential', 'private and confidential',
  'for your eyes only', 'do not forward'
];

const items = $input.all();
const results = [];

for (const item of items) {
  const subject = (item.json.headers?.subject || item.json.subject || '').toLowerCase();
  const body = (item.json.headers?.text || item.json.headers?.html || item.json.text || item.json.snippet || '').toLowerCase();
  const from = (item.json.headers?.from || item.json.from || '').toLowerCase();
  const fullText = `${subject} ${body} ${from}`;
  
  const matchedKeywords = phishingKeywords.filter(keyword => 
    fullText.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())
  );
  
  if (matchedKeywords.length > 0) {
    results.push({
      json: {
        ...item.json,
        phishguard: {
          matchedKeywords: matchedKeywords,
          keywordCount: matchedKeywords.length,
          scanTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          initialRiskLevel: matchedKeywords.length >= 5
            ? 'CRITICAL'
            : matchedKeywords.length >= 3
              ? 'HIGH'
              : matchedKeywords.length >= 2
                ? 'MEDIUM'
                : 'LOW'
        }
      },
      binary: item.binary
    });
  }
}

if (results.length === 0) {
  return [];
}

return results;

parameters.command: =echo "=== WHOIS ===" && whois {{ $json.parsed.headers.senderDomain }} | head -30 && echo "=== DIG ===" && dig {{ $json.parsed.headers.senderDomain }} ANY +short && echo "=== NSLOOKUP MX ===" && nslookup -type=mx {{ $json.parsed.headers.senderDomain }} && echo "=== SPF CHECK ===" && dig {{ $json.parsed.headers.senderDomain }} TXT +short | grep -i spf && echo "=== DMARC CHECK ===" && dig _dmarc.{{ $json.parsed.headers.senderDomain }} TXT +short
